subject: Guardian
text: The Guardian has around 2000 HP.

evidence.quote: This guy has around 2000 HP, so get ready for a long fight.

subject: Guardian
text: The Guardian casts Flame and Blizzard, hitting all party members for around 50-80 HP.

evidence.quote: considering that his Flame and Blizzard spells, (which attack all, mind you) deal around 50-80 HP to everyone!

subject: Guardian
text: Having Hero and Lufia consecutively use Drain for about four rounds depletes the Guardian of his defense.

evidence.quote: At the start of the battle, have Hero and Lufia consecutively use Drain for about four rounds. This'll totally deplete the Guardian of his defense, which will extremely up the damage you're doing to him.

subject: Guardian
text: Defeating the Guardian on the ninth floor allows the party to obtain the Light Key.

evidence.quote: where you'll meet the Guardian, a little cronie of the Sinistrals... After the battle Amos and Gades will come and beat the snot out of you. Take the Light Key and fall out of the tower.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Dropping down the hole on the first floor leads to six treasures scattered in the corners of the room.

evidence.quote: Start off your climb by dropping down the hole in front of you! Take the six treasures scattered in the corners of the room, and proceed up the steps.

subject: Stone Cure
text: A Stone Cure can be grabbed in the room before taking the stairs to the third level.

evidence.quote: As is usually the case in this tower, the doors lead to the same room, which you can grab a Stone Cure and go to the third level.

subject: Revive
text: Two Revives are located on the third floor, one in the room above and another down below.

evidence.quote: Go into the room above and take the Revive. Go down and take another Revive, then into the right room, but watch out!

subject: Ex Magic
text: Taking the left path on the third floor yields an Ex Magic and an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Take the left path and recieve and Ex Magic and Ex Potion.

subject: Miracle
text: A Miracle is located at the end of the long path in the right room of the fifth floor.

evidence.quote: Follow the unneccessarily long path and take the Miracle at the end, then go aaaaaaaaall the way back to the fifth floor.

subject: Ex Potion
text: A fourth Ex Potion can be found on the right side of the fifth floor before falling down a hole.

evidence.quote: Continue up the right side for your fourth Ex Potion, then simply fall down a hole.

subject: Power Gourd
text: Following the path in the south room of the sixth floor leads to a Power Gourd.

evidence.quote: Take the south room and follow the path to get the Power Gourd.

subject: Gloom Voice
text: A Gloom Voice is located on the seventh floor, surrounded by holes on all sides except the top.

evidence.quote: The first treasure you see is surrounded by holes, except for the top, so go up there and get the Gloom Voice.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Down the stairs in the northeast house of Linze, following the red path leads to three treasures.

evidence.quote: When you're ready, head down the stairs in the northeast house, until you come to a red and green path. The red path leads to three treasures.

subject: Stone Cure
text: A Stone Cure and an Escape are located in the upper-left corner of the entry floor.

evidence.quote: Take the Stone Cure and Escape up in the left corner, to get to them just walk left, up, left, up, etc.

subject: Ex Potion
text: An Ex Potion and a Hi Magic are located straight to the right from the entrance steps.

evidence.quote: On the right there is a Ex Potion and Hi Magic. Just head straight right from the steps.

subject: Ex Bomb
text: Walking downward parallel with the left path leads to an Ex Bomb and a Revive at the bottom.

evidence.quote: There are two on the bottom. Walk downwards, paralell with the left one to make it to the Ex Bomb and Revive.

subject: Alumina
text: Falling down a hole gives access to a stairway that leads to the Alumina.

evidence.quote: You'll fall down a hole, but, you'll have access to a stairway that will give you the Alumina!

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Three treasures can be found on the second floor after falling through the hole.

evidence.quote: Take the three treasures on the second floor, then go back up.

subject: Ex Potion
text: An Ex Potion and an Ex Bomb are found in the bottom-left corner by clinging to the right side and heading parallel with the boxes.

evidence.quote: There is an Ex Potion and Ex Bomb left in the bottom left corner, take those by clinging to the right side, and then heading left, parallel with the boxes.

subject: Revive
text: Entering the left room under the upper-right treasures yields a Revive.

evidence.quote: Then you'll see three doors. Go in the left room and get the Revive.

subject: Ex Magic
text: Entering the right room beyond the three doors yields an Ex Magic and an Ex Potion.

evidence.quote: Head in the right one and take the Ex Magic and Ex Potion.

subject: Switch
text: Pushing the switch in the middle room causes the portal in the left room to warp to a different place.

evidence.quote: Now all you have left is the middle room, which doesn't contain steps or a portal at all! It has a switch. Push it down, but nothing seems to happen. Well, now the portal in the left room warps you to an entirely different place.

subject: Ex Arrows
text: An Ex Potion is found after warping, and the upper chest on the lower level of the second floor contains Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: Take the Ex Potion and head down the next set of stairs. Now you're on the lower level of the second floor. Check the upper chest for some Ex Arrows, and then continue right.

subject: Revive
text: Continuing right and heading up on the lower level of the second floor yields another Revive.

evidence.quote: Go up and take another Revive.

subject: Opal
text: Following the hallway to the bottom part of the cavern leads to an Opal.

evidence.quote: Cotinue around to the top right room, and follow the hallway that leads to the bottom part of the cavern. Take the Opal, and then continue into the lower room

subject: Silver Sword
text: Taking the Ex Potion in the lower room warps the party to a plateau containing the Silver Sword.

evidence.quote: taking the Ex Potion, which'll warp you to a small plateau and gives you the Silver Sword, a new weapon for Hero.

subject: Power Gourd
text: A Power Gourd and a Mind Gourd can be found while descending the small ladders toward the third floor.

evidence.quote: Go down the small ladders, taking the Power Gourd and Mind Gourd on your way, then go down the big long ladder.

subject: Revive
text: A Revive is found at the base of the long ladder on the third floor.

evidence.quote: then go down the big long ladder. Take the Revive, and then walk across the bridge and into the bottom room.

subject: Crown Jewels
text: The task in Grenoble to find the Crown Jewels on the 7th level of the Old Cave awards 10,000 Gold.

evidence.quote: Warp back to Grenoble and take up the task of finding the Crown Jewels. 10,000 Gold! Yee-haw! Now *that*'s a task. Go down to the 7th level

subject: Sweet Water
text: A Sweet Water is found upon reaching the 7th level of the Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Go down to the 7th level, and take the Sweet Water.

subject: Gloom Pick
text: A Gloom Pick is located inside the muck on the 7th level of the Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Go into the muck and grab the Gloom Pick.

subject: Ex Potion
text: An Ex Potion is located on the right side of the muck.

evidence.quote: On the right side, snag the Ex Potion and go into the room.

subject: Gloom Voice
text: A Gloom Voice is hidden on the right side of the highest row in the muck.

evidence.quote: In the next cavern, there is a Gloom Voice hidden on the right side of the highest row in the muck.

subject: Ex Magic
text: An Ex Magic can be retrieved down the steps before heading up.

evidence.quote: Down the steps, take the Ex Magic and head up.

subject: Power Potion
text: A Power Potion and a Spell Potion are located along the upper path.

evidence.quote: Continuing on the upper path, take the Power and Spell Potions.

subject: Buster Sword
text: Heading up the steps yields a Buster Sword for Hero.

evidence.quote: Go up the steps and grab the Buster Sword, an awesome sword for Hero.

subject: Crown Jewels
text: Inside the room are the Crown Jewels and two Miracles.

evidence.quote: Go in the room and take the Crown Jewels and two Miracles, but you're in no way done in this cave!

subject: Hi Magic
text: A Hi Magic is found in the lower hallway of the underground passage.

evidence.quote: Go back down into the underground passage, and take the lower hallway and take the Hi Magic.

subject: Float
text: Climbing up the ladder leads to an Ex Potion and a Float.

evidence.quote: Now head up the ladder. Get the Ex Potion and Float, and then go through the door.

subject: Great Potion
text: A Great Potion is found to the left after passing through the door.

evidence.quote: Take the Great Potion to your left.

subject: Spell Potion
text: Another Spell Potion and Power Potion are situated below before descending the ladder.

evidence.quote: Take another Spell and Power Potion below, and then go down the ladder.

subject: Ex Magic
text: An Ex Magic and a Miracle can be retrieved across the muck before descending the steps.

evidence.quote: Take the Ex Magic, and then go across the muck and recieve the Miracle, then go down the steps.

subject: Ex Potion
text: An Ex Potion is located on the lower level before continuing onward.

evidence.quote: On the lower level, take the Ex Potion and continue on.

subject: Wind Flute
text: Taking the treasure on the left and entering the room yields the Wind Flute.

evidence.quote: On the left, take the treasure and enter the room for the Wind Flute, a myster-ious item.

subject: Clear Silk
text: A Clear Silk is found up the hallway, and climbing the ladder yields a Miracle.

evidence.quote: Up the hallway, take the Clear Silk, and then climb the ladder to get a Miracle.

subject: Mind Potion
text: A Mind Potion and an Escape are found down the steps on the bottom right.

evidence.quote: Down the steps, take the Mind Potion on the bottom right and continue along, nabbing the Escape.

subject: Power Potion
text: A Power Potion is located to the right of the north hallway in Marse Cave.

evidence.quote: Anyway, there is a Power Potion to the right of the north hallway. That's how short this cave is.

subject: Marse Shop
text: Equipment sold in Marse includes Silver Rod, Silver Armor, Silver Plate, Silver Helm, Silver Wrist, and Silver Robe.

evidence.quote: Buy the girls each a Silver Rod. Buy a Silver Armor, Silver Plate, and Silver Helm for Hero, a Silver Armor, Silver Plate, and Silver Helm for Aguro, a Silver Wrist for Lufia, and a Silver Robe and Silver Wrist for Jerin.
